description: This PHP source file defines the Response class, which extends the Target class, and provides methods for generating database backup scripts for vtiger CRM, including starting, processing tables, and finishing backups.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class for generating database backup scripts for vtiger CRM, handling table structure and data dumping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Response object with database configuration and UTF8 support option.

methods.name: startBackup
methods.description: Outputs initial SQL statements and settings for starting a database backup.

methods.name: processTableCreateStatement
methods.description: Outputs SQL statements for creating a table and preparing for data dump.

methods.name: startTableBackup
methods.description: Outputs SQL statements to lock a table and disable keys before data insertion.

methods.name: processStatement
methods.description: Outputs a SQL statement, typically for data insertion.

methods.name: finishTableBackup
methods.description: Outputs SQL statements to enable keys and unlock the table after data dump.

methods.name: finishBackup
methods.description: Outputs SQL statements to restore previous database settings after backup completion.
